response.original_title: Manchester United F.C. - The Inside Story
response.overview: Here we go! For the first time we take you behind the scenes at Manchester United, the best known football club in the world. Follow the United stars through a training session as they prepare for a big game. See how they relax away from the pressures of modem day football. Travel on board the Manchester United team coach and see how Alex Ferguson and his backroom staff prepare for an important fixture. Join the players for the pre-match meal and in their hotel rooms. Eavesdrop on a board meeting at Old Trafford and hear from the men who make United tick
response.title: Manchester United F.C. - The Inside Story
